description: This PHP source file defines the 'Api' model class within the Opencart admin module for the User API. It provides methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving API records and related data such as IP addresses and history logs from the database.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A model class for managing API records related to users, including CRUD operations and associated IP and history data.

methods.name: addApi
methods.description: Creates a new API record in the database with optional IP addresses.

methods.name: editApi
methods.description: Updates an existing API record and its associated IP addresses.

methods.name: deleteApi
methods.description: Deletes an API record and its associated IP addresses from the database.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Retrieves a specific API record by its ID.

methods.name: getApis
methods.description: Retrieves a list of API records with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalApis
methods.description: Returns the total count of API records.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address for a specified API record.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes all IP addresses associated with a specific API record.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses associated with a specific API record.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves API access history records with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total number of history records for a specific API.
